models_evaluated: ChatGPT (described as example of AI in vignette)

links.outcome: Patient trust in doctor and intention to seek help when told doctor uses AI
links.effect: Disclosing doctor's AI use reduced intention to seek help (β=-0.45, P<.001), trust as person (β=-.33) and as professional (β=-.40); means 0.63 No AI vs 0.30 Extensive AI.
links.quote: Mentioning a doctor’s use of AI significantly decreased respondents’ trust in the doctor, both as a person and as a professional, and in turn, reduced their intention to seek help (partial mediation in both Republicans and the full sample).

links.outcome: Patient reactions to AI-use disclosure in doctor profile
links.effect: Plain disclosure of AI use lowered trust and help-seeking across demographics; trust gap smaller with AI use frequency (β=.09) and larger with self-reported knowledge (β=-.04, P=.08).
links.quote: Therefore, merely incorporating AI into medical diagnoses without solid trust-building ethics may inadvertently reduce patient’s trust.

links.outcome: Moderating effect of AI knowledge and AI use frequency on AI trust gap
links.effect: Trust gap shrank with AI use frequency (β=.09, P<.001) but expanded with self-reported AI knowledge (β=-.04, P=.08); knowledge-based education may backfire.
links.quote: Conversely, people with higher self-reported knowledge of AI showed larger gaps in trust and visiting intention.

links.outcome: Trust and intention after AI-use description
links.effect: Trust/intention means: control 0.50, No AI 0.63, Extensive AI 0.30, Moderate AI 0.34; intention β=-.45, 95% CI -0.49 to -0.40; P<.001.
links.quote: Mentioning that the doctor uses AI to assist in diagnosis consistently decreased trust and intention to seek help.

links.outcome: Patient trust and intention to seek help

links.quote: Mentioning a doctor’s use of AI significantly decreased respondents’ trust in the doctor, both as a person and as a professional, and in turn, reduced their intention to seek help (partial mediation in both Republicans and the full sample).
